current.text: Yahoo lists him as questionable with a groin injury.
Miami traded for Giannis Antetokounmpo, so Bam now plays next to him.
Giannis should cost him a little value. He may lose some rebounds and take more threes, but experts do not expect a big drop.
He is a lock to start in the frontcourt with Giannis and Wiggins.
Miami's frontcourt depth is thin. Backup centers are Nick Richards and Vlad Goldin, and Bobby Portis backs him up at forward.
With Giannis handling the ball a lot, Miami's offense should move away from last season's very high pace and few ball screens.
He was not blocking shots, but he may do more rim protection with Giannis next to him.
His passing picked up late last season, back to about 4.5 assists over the final 15 to 20 games.
He shot about 29% from three over the final 25 games of last season.
His shooting is expected to improve this season.
ESPN's rank (7th in categories, 15th overall) is too high. Do not draft him at that price. A rank in the 30s is more reasonable.
He is fair value in round 3 of category drafts, around picks 29 to 36. Yahoo's rank of 26 is about right.
His ADP range is tight, about picks 19 to 39.
In auctions he is worth the mid 20s USD. 24 USD in a mock auction was too cheap.
One expert (Dan) is not a big fan of him this year.
Experts rank him higher in points leagues (late round 2, 20th in Yahoo points) than in categories.
With the March 28 end, Miami has a weak 4-3-3 playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21.
Miami has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs and none in the fantasy playoffs.
The East is very stacked, so Miami may not be able to coast and rest players for long stretches.

durable.text: His category profile is broad for a big. Rebounds, points and steals are his strengths, and he adds some threes and assists for his position.
FG% is his weak category. It is low for a big on about 16 attempts per game.

note: He went for 26 USD in our league last season. Yahoo and ESPN average costs are about 27 USD, and experts call the mid 20s fair, so bid up to about 27 USD and do not pay ESPN's 43 USD value. His FG% is the weak spot, so he fits best in punt FG% builds, where his rebounds, points, steals and threes from a big all count. Before the draft, check the groin status (Yahoo Q). Early in the season, watch how his rebounds, threes and blocks change next to Giannis, and remember Miami gets only 10 playoff games.
